name: pine-mobile
description: The mobile app for pine: the desktop app's page on a phone, for the pine of another machine

scripts.sync:ios: vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs android assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs android assembleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync:ios && cap run ios --no-sync
